name: 3d-fabric
description: The complete 3D toolchain in one plugin: printable CAD by natural language through the local SolidCraft CLI (build, edit, measure, preview, inspect, repair), plus thirty Blender skills for organic modelling, materials, lighting, cameras, rendering and animation. The Blender half is the MIT-licensed cc-blender-skill suite by RobLe3 (github.com/RobLe3/cc-blender-skill), bundled verbatim.
